en.quote: We will not increase the tax burden on non-resource sectors.
en.head: Corporate income tax rose to 25%; VAT to 22%.
en.body: The corporate income-tax rate rose from 20% to 25% in 2025, and the standard VAT rate from 20% to 22% in 2026. Both taxes also affect non-resource industries. These changes came many years after the article, so the comparison concerns a long-term policy pledge, not an immediate reversal.
